Google Drive Live Sync

4-Player Phone Leaderboard Sync

1. Your Linked Google Drive Sheet Open Sheet →

Your Element Helix MRAD Squad Leaderboard sheet is created inside your Retical trainer folder on Google Drive with tabs for Leaderboard, Shot_Log, and Apps_Script_Setup.

2. Connect Google Apps Script Web App URL (2-Way Phone Write Sync)

In your Google Sheet, click Extensions → Apps Script, paste the script below (also saved in Tab 3 of your Sheet), click Deploy → New deployment → Web app (Anyone), and paste the Web App URL here:

View Google Apps Script Code (Pre-Configured for Your Drive Sheet) 
const SPREADSHEET_ID = '15BPRT9ws5yL33EAOWb_5Jkom-YUReUAX5whURSXDoTs';
const PLAYERS = ['Justin', 'Cobus', 'Wayne', 'Rhys'];

function doGet() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('Leaderboard');
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const stats = {};
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    const r = data[i];
    const name = String(r[1] || '').trim();
    if (PLAYERS.includes(name)) {
      stats[name] = {
        name,
        streak: Number(r[2]) || 0,
        bestStreak: Number(r[3]) || 0,
        bestTimeMs: r[4] && r[4] !== '--' ? Math.round(Number(r[4]) * 1000) : null,
        hits: Number(r[6]) || 0,
        shots: Number(r[7]) || 0,
        lastTimeMs: r[9] && r[9] !== '--' ? Math.round(Number(r[9]) * 1000) : null,
        totalHitTimeMs: Number(r[10]) || 0
      };
    }
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, stats }))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);
  try {
    const payload = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
    const lb = ss.getSheetByName('Leaderboard');
    const log = ss.getSheetByName('Shot_Log');
    const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
    if (payload.stats) {
      const rows = lb.getDataRange().getValues();
      for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
        const name = String(rows[i][1] || '').trim();
        if (payload.stats[name]) {
          const st = payload.stats[name];
          const rowNum = i + 1;
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 3).setValue(st.streak || 0);
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 4).setValue(st.bestStreak || 0);
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 5).setValue(st.bestTimeMs ? Number((st.bestTimeMs / 1000).toFixed(2)) : '--');
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 7).setValue(st.hits || 0);
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 8).setValue(st.shots || 0);
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 10).setValue(st.lastTimeMs ? Number((st.lastTimeMs / 1000).toFixed(2)) : '--');
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 11).setValue(st.totalHitTimeMs || 0);
          lb.getRange(rowNum, 12).setValue(nowStr);
        }
      }
    }
    if (payload.shot && log) {
      const s = payload.shot;
      log.appendRow([nowStr, s.player, s.isHit ? 'HIT' : 'MISS', (s.responseTimeMs / 1000).toFixed(2), s.spotterCall, s.userHold, s.radialErrorMrad, s.toleranceMrad, s.reticleType, s.zoom]);
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, updatedAt: nowStr }))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}
